import argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, struct, subprocess, tempfile
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument('--candidate')
ap.add_argument('--commit')
a = ap.parse_args()
D = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
C = pathlib.Path(a.candidate) if a.candidate else D / 'candidate'
P = 'reports/cc16_native_gui_icon_state_prefix_cleanup_storage.json'
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
checks = []


def g(*args, data=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], input=data, env=env)


def read(path):
    return g('show', a.commit + ':' + path) if a.commit else (C / path).read_bytes()


def ck(name, value):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(name)
    checks.append(name)


r = json.loads(read(P))
ck('reader exact embedded bytes', pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes() == r['reader']['utf8'].encode())
ck('reader immutable tuple', len(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()) == r['reader']['bytes']
   and sha(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()) == r['reader']['sha256'])
for q in r['source_pairs']:
    old = g('show', r['base'] + ':' + q['path'])
    new = read(q['path'])
    ck('whole preimage ' + q['path'], len(old) == q['before_bytes'] and sha(old) == q['before_sha256'])
    ck('whole postimage ' + q['path'], len(new) == q['after_bytes'] and sha(new) == q['after_sha256'])
    value = old.decode()
    for i, s in enumerate(q['seams']):
        ck('forward seam unique ' + q['path'] + str(i), value.count(s['before_utf8']) == 1)
        value = value.replace(s['before_utf8'], s['after_utf8'], 1)
    ck('whole forward ' + q['path'], value.encode() == new)
    for i, s in reversed(list(enumerate(q['seams']))):
        ck('reverse seam unique ' + q['path'] + str(i), value.count(s['after_utf8']) == 1)
        value = value.replace(s['after_utf8'], s['before_utf8'], 1)
    ck('whole reverse ' + q['path'], value.encode() == old)
    if q['path'].endswith('.hpp'):
        tokens = lambda b: re.sub(r'\s+', '', re.sub(r'//[^\n]*|/\*.*?\*/', '', b.decode(), flags=re.S))
        ck('all declarations/layout unchanged ' + q['path'], tokens(old) == tokens(new))
    else:
        c = new.decode()
        s = q['seams'][0]
        ck('normal loop preserved except indentation ' + q['path'], '\n'.join(
            line[4:] for line in s['after_utf8'].splitlines()[1:s['after_utf8'].splitlines().index('    } catch (...) {')])
           == s['before_utf8'])
        catch = c[c.index('    } catch (...) {'):]
        endpoint = ('static_cast<volatile std::uint32_t&>(frame.progress_14)'
                    if 'repeat_storage' in q['path'] else 'actual_stack_homes[0]')
        ck('begin then actual current published endpoint ' + q['path'],
           catch.index('frame.begin_18') < catch.index(endpoint))
        ck('both catch operands captured only once ' + q['path'],
           catch.count('frame.begin_18') == 1 and catch.count(endpoint) == 1)
        ck('real forward destruction then advance then original rethrow ' + q['path'],
           catch.index('while (cleanup_cursor != cleanup_end)')
           < catch.index('destroy_native_gui_icon_state_00ab3280(')
           < catch.index('cleanup_cursor += 0x40u;') < catch.index('throw;'))
        ck('single ordinary catch no phase Origin partial cleanup terminal ' + q['path'],
           c.count('catch (...)') == 1 and catch.count('throw;') == 1
           and not any(x in catch for x in ['if (', 'try {', 'noexcept', 'terminate', 'current_exception',
                                            'state_04', 'slot_1c', 'placement_20', 'release(', 'new ',
                                            'Origin', 'failure_runtime']))

q = r['doc']
ck('complete new doc', len(read(q['path'])) == q['bytes'] and sha(read(q['path'])) == q['sha256'])
for q in r['unchanged_provider_pins']:
    b = g('show', r['base'] + ':' + q['path'])
    ck('whole genuine provider ' + q['path'], len(b) == q['bytes'] and sha(b) == q['sha256'])

regions = {q['name']: q for q in r['Native']['regions']}
ins = {}
for name in ['AB3A70', 'AB3280', 'AB4C50', 'AB5400', 'AB3280_name_action',
             'AB4C50_placement_action', 'AB5400_placement_action', 'placement_delete']:
    q = regions[name]
    b = bytes.fromhex(q['hex'])
    ck('whole installed Native bytes ' + name, len(b) == q['bytes'] and sha(b) == q['sha256'])
    ins[name] = list(Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32).disasm(b, q['address']))
    ck('whole Native instruction coverage ' + name,
       len(ins[name]) == q['ops'] and sum(i.size for i in ins[name]) == len(b))
ck('AB3A70 no local FS EH setup', len(ins['AB3A70']) == 69
   and not any('fs:' in i.op_str for i in ins['AB3A70']))
ck('AB3A70 terminal increment after current texture capture',
   next(i.op_str for i in ins['AB3A70'] if i.address == 0xab3b06) == 'eax, dword ptr [esi]'
   and next(i.op_str for i in ins['AB3A70'] if i.address == 0xab3b19) == 'dword ptr [0xce221c]')
for name, action in [('AB4C50', 0xcb7c00), ('AB5400', 0xcb7c90)]:
    f = struct.unpack('<9I', bytes.fromhex(regions[name + '_FuncInfo']['hex']))
    u = [struct.unpack_from('<iI', bytes.fromhex(regions[name + '_unwind']['hex']), i * 8) for i in range(3)]
    t = struct.unpack('<5I', bytes.fromhex(regions[name + '_try']['hex']))
    ck('actual 3-state EH/no catch-state cleanup action ' + name,
       f[0] == 0x19930522 and f[1] == 3 and f[3] == 1
       and u == [(-1, 0), (0, action), (-1, 0)] and t[:4] == (0, 1, 2, 1))
    x = ins[name + '_placement_action']
    ck('actual private slot operands and real no-op placement call ' + name,
       [(i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in x] == [
           ('mov', 'eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x1c]'), ('push', 'eax'),
           ('mov', 'ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x20]'), ('push', 'ecx'),
           ('call', '0x401130'), ('add', 'esp, 8'), ('ret', '')])
ck('placement delete is exactly RET', bytes.fromhex(regions['placement_delete']['hex']) == b'\xc3')
for name, start, end, published in [('AB4C50', 0xab4caa, 0xab4cc6, 'edi, dword ptr [ebp + 8]'),
                                    ('AB5400', 0xab545b, 0xab5477, 'edi, dword ptr [ebp - 0x14]')]:
    x = [i for i in ins[name] if start <= i.address <= end]
    ck('all 13 prefix-landing rows ' + name, len(x) == 13)
    ck('Native begin then published end capture ' + name,
       x[0].op_str == 'esi, dword ptr [ebp - 0x18]' and x[1].op_str == published)
    ck('Native direct prefix destructor and bare rethrow helper ' + name,
       [i.op_str for i in x if i.mnemonic == 'call'] == ['0xab3280', '0xbf6885']
       and [(i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in x[-4:]]
       == [('xor', 'ebx, ebx'), ('push', 'ebx'), ('push', 'ebx'), ('call', '0xbf6885')])
f = struct.unpack('<9I', bytes.fromhex(regions['AB3280_FuncInfo']['hex']))
ck('AB3280 actual one name-unwind state no try block',
   f[1] == 1 and f[3] == 0
   and struct.unpack('<iI', bytes.fromhex(regions['AB3280_unwind']['hex'])) == (-1, 0xcb7a50))
ck('AB3280 actual receiver+4 name action', [(i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in ins['AB3280_name_action']]
   == [('mov', 'ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x10]'), ('add', 'ecx, 4'), ('jmp', '0x41dd20')])
ck('no new credit Native authority or current disposal', r['new_credit'] == 0
   and r['readiness']['new_Native_Origin_or_NoThrow_authority'] is False
   and r['readiness']['failed_current_automatic_disposition'] is False)

parent = g('show', '-s', '--format=%P', a.commit).decode().strip() if a.commit else r['base']
ck('actual one parent or candidate baseline', len(parent.split()) == 1)
for q in r['source_pairs']:
    ck('actual preimage affinity ' + q['path'], sha(g('show', parent + ':' + q['path'])) == q['before_sha256'])
for q in r['unchanged_provider_pins']:
    ck('actual unchanged provider affinity ' + q['path'], sha(g('show', parent + ':' + q['path'])) == q['sha256'])

fd, index_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='prefix_cleanup_index_', dir=D)
os.close(fd)
pathlib.Path(index_path).unlink()
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(pathlib.Path(index_path).resolve()))
try:
    g('read-tree', parent, env=env)
    for path in r['owned_paths']:
        oid = g('hash-object', '-w', '--stdin', data=read(path)).decode().strip()
        g('update-index', '--add', '--cacheinfo', '100644,' + oid + ',' + path, env=env)
    forward = g('write-tree', env=env).decode().strip()
    changed = set(g('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z', parent, env=env).decode().strip('\0').split('\0'))
    ck('full forward exactly4M2A paths', changed == set(r['owned_paths']))
    if a.commit:
        ck('actual full forward tree', forward == g('rev-parse', a.commit + '^{tree}').decode().strip())
    for q in r['source_pairs']:
        g('update-index', '--cacheinfo', '100644,' + q['before_blob'] + ',' + q['path'], env=env)
    for path in r['owned_paths'][4:]:
        g('update-index', '--force-remove', path, env=env)
    reverse = g('write-tree', env=env).decode().strip()
    ck('full six-path recursive reverse tree', reverse == g('rev-parse', parent + '^{tree}').decode().strip())
finally:
    pathlib.Path(index_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)

print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'checks': len(checks), 'mode': 'actual Git' if a.commit else 'ignored candidate',
                  'base': r['base'], 'parent': parent, 'Source_pairs': 4, 'paths': 6,
                  'seams': sum(len(q['seams']) for q in r['source_pairs']),
                  'forward_tree': forward, 'reverse_tree': reverse,
                  'new_credit': 0, 'Native_OriginalABI_Origin_runtime_activation': False}))
